scripts.build: node scripts/clean-prisma.js && npx prisma generate && tsc
scripts.start: node scripts/clean-prisma.js && npx prisma generate && node dist/server.js
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/setup-env.js && node scripts/clean-prisma.js && npx prisma generate
scripts.migrate: node scripts/setup-env.js && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.release: node scripts/setup-env.js && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.email:verify: node -r dotenv/config -r ts-node/register/transpile-only -e "const { verifyEmailTransport, isEmailServiceConfigured } = require('./src/services/Email/emailService'); (async () => { if (!isEmailServiceConfigured()) { console.error('Not configured: set RESEND_API_KEY or EMAIL_USER + EMAIL_PASS'); process.exit(2);} await verifyEmailTransport(); console.log('Email transport verify OK'); })().catch(e => { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.prisma:generate: node scripts/setup-env.js && node scripts/clean-prisma.js && npx prisma generate
scripts.prisma:push: node scripts/setup-env.js && npx prisma db push
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: node scripts/setup-env.js && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prisma:migrate:dev: node scripts/setup-env.js && npx prisma migrate dev
